subject.title: [do not merge] refactor: flip sessions and transcripts to sqlite storage

question: Should OpenClaw accept this one-way SQLite storage cutover and removal of the active file-shaped Plugin SDK compatibility family as the supported upgrade contract?
rationale: This protected PR changes sensitive persisted session data, recovery behavior, operator downgrade expectations, and shipped external Plugin SDK surfaces; tests cannot decide whether that compatibility boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Approve the one-way cutover
options.body: Accept SQLite as the sole runtime store, remove the old SDK file surfaces, and require exact-head upgrade and recovery proof before merge.

options.title: Split the API removal
options.body: Land the storage migration separately while preserving or deferring the disputed external Plugin SDK compatibility changes.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Keep the canonical tracker open but stop this branch if the upgrade or external API contract is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Approve the one-way cutover
recommendation.body: Accept SQLite as the sole runtime store, remove the old SDK file surfaces, and require exact-head upgrade and recovery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership spans the central session, SQLite, Plugin SDK, and Codex surfaces, and this choice needs repository-wide compatibility authority.
